objective: Preallocate scan-path schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate scan schema keys
tasks.result: Scan-table schema lookups now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in scan_table_base() and scan_table_filtered() schema lookup key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, table/view resolution, full scans, index fallbacks, row-cache behavior, and SQL query results are unchanged.
Focused scan/select tests printed Cargo file-lock waits before passing.
